subject: Roshan character animation: whole-figure frames
question: Review of the 2D-deformation wave (revision 1), where a cut-out arm moved over a body taken from another drawing with per-part delays.
decision: Rejected: "No arm moves as a single figure, the whole body moves at once, drawn as a whole frame." No limb moves as a separate piece; every frame is one whole drawing of the figure and the whole body moves together.
